Tom Scott was raised in a musical family and has become one of the most iconic musicians in Los Angeles and around the world. He is a first-call studio musician, a T.V. and film composer, and his saxophone solos can be heard in hundreds of pop and jazz recordings.
Tom was interviewed via Zoom on April 1, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m extremely pleased to have Tom Scott with me here. It’s morning in your time zone and I’m in the afternoon. And thank you so much for joining me.
